items: Wild owls, bats and ravens now fly: they circle out of reach above you, then telegraph and swoop down at you
You can only hit or invite a flyer during its swoop and the moment it skims the ground
Swoops aim where you're going: keep walking straight and you'll be caught, but a blink or a turn as it dives makes it miss
A swoop's aim locks a moment before it dives, so even a fast bat can be dodged with a well-timed blink
